')[0] rows2 = second_table.split('') print("\n=== SECOND TABLE - All numeric values with leading digit '1' ===") count2 = 0 for row in rows2[2:]: # Skip first 2 rows (column headers) tds = re.findall(r'([^<]*)', row) if tds: for val in tds[1:]: # Skip first column (row header) val = val.strip() if val and val not in ['*', 'r', 'r/', ''] and not val.startswith('/'): clean_val = val.replace(',', '').split('.')[0] if clean_val and clean_val.lstrip('-').isdigit(): if clean_val[0] == '1': count2 += 1 print(f" {val}") print(f"\nSecond table total: {count2}") print(f"\n=== GRAND TOTAL: {count + count2} ===") EOF
